title: Copperlane (Veronica Garg) — founding engineers, CV ready
summary: MIN-207: Completed lead analysis, executive positioning, 1-page tailored CV generation, 300 DPI HD PNG render, direct outreach package for Veronica Garg (@v_garg_s) / Copperlane AI, and strategic intelligence brief for Copperlane (YC W26; Founders: Athan Zhang, Brianna Lin). Positioning built on the 6-Month Automation Arc ('I don't come to warm a chair') and the Penny autonomous loan officer breakthrough (compressing 4+ hours of manual mortgage document review into deterministic minutes with human-in-the-loop). PDF generated via ReportLab and verified via pypdf and PyMuPDF: exactly 1 page, zero text collisions, mortgage ops heading carefully balanced, 154pt bottom margin breathing room. Actionable One-Tap Application Card and multiple DM options staged for Principal Pavel Cherkashin. Copies staged in workspace/goals/goal-4/files/copperlane/. Zero outbound messages sent.
limitations: Hiring post on X named traits (>highly motivated, >fast learner, >care about problems) and on-site SF rather than a rigid job specification; materials are founder-aligned and systems-focused.
Internal autonomous fleet throughput figures (>=20 issues/day, >=1 project/week) are omitted pending third-party audit.
MiniMax M3.1 Flash speed/throughput numbers in post thread are vendor benchmarks, not Copperlane internal figures, and are excluded.
Founding Engineer is conventionally an IC role; CV explicitly positions Pavel as a high-leverage builder through autonomous systems and shipped code.
Zero auto-apply rule strictly enforced: all assets staged in review; outbound dispatch requires human tap.
